title: Cyber Resilience
items: A process that identifies and responds to security threats before they can damage data or systems
Ransomware Threat Detection 是在威脅損害資料或系統前加以辨識並回應的流程。
What does ransomware typically do to data?
Ransomware 會加密資料；Wiperware 會刪除資料；Exfiltration 則竊取資料但保持完整。
What does wiperware aim to do?
Steal data while leaving it intact
Wiperware Threat Detection 分析相同特徵，專門偵測以毀損資料為目的的攻擊。
Data is accessed and sent to attackers without necessarily being modified or destroyed
Exfiltration 攻擊竊取資料並傳給攻擊者，資料在系統上不一定被修改或毀損。
Which information theory concept is used to characterize the workload for ransomware detection?
Ransomware 偵測使用 Shannon Entropy 等資訊理論統計描述目前工作負載。
Why is entropy-based analysis computationally expensive?
It requires reading the entire pool every minute
此類分析需逐位元組處理資料，運算成本高。
Which component provides computational storage offload for threat detection statistics?
FCM Drive 以 Computational Storage 在 Drive 內卸載運算並彙整統計。
Which minimum FCM firmware level processes data statistics within the drive?
FCM 4.2 以上 Firmware 會在 Drive 內處理資料統計。
On what basis are threat detection statistics presented to the FlashSystem?
統計依 Volume Group 呈現，由所有參與 Drive 彙總成每個 Volume Group 的統計。
Who is notified when the FlashSystem determines a potential threat?
FlashSystem 彙總並分析威脅可能性後，通知 IBM Storage Insights。
How often are compression and cyber resiliency statistics for volumes collected for Storage Insights?
Volume 的壓縮與 Cyber Resiliency 統計每 5 分鐘收集，Storage Insights 據此建立歷史模型。
How does IBM Storage Insights identify where ransomware attacks might be occurring?
By building a historical model of the storage system and using built-in intelligence
By reading the audit log only
Storage Insights 以統計建立儲存系統的歷史模型，並以內建智慧與公式判斷攻擊可能發生的時間與位置。
Where is ransomware threat detection configured in the management GUI?
於 Settings > Security > Ransomware Threat Detection 面板設定。
Concept Guide Ch18 Ransomware threat detection
What happens when an event is raised due to data destruction?
Affected volumes in the volume group automatically have a snapshot triggered
因資料毀損觸發 Event 時，Volume Group 中受影響的 Volume 會自動觸發 Snapshot。
Concept Guide Ch18 Ransomware threat detection
How is a snapshot automatically triggered by data destruction detection marked?
自動觸發的 Snapshot 標示為 Detected threat triggered，可能包含部分異常工作負載。
If an earlier volume group snapshot exists when an anomaly is detected, how is the latest snapshot marked?
既有的最新 Snapshot 會標示為 Retention extended，並延長保留以免提早到期。
How are volume group snapshots created while an alert exists marked?
Alert 存在期間建立的 Snapshot 會標示為 Potential threat present。
By default, to how many days is the latest volume group snapshot's expiration extended after a threat detection event?
偵測到異常時，若最新 Snapshot 會更早到期，預設延長為 7 天。
Concept Guide Ch4 Note；簡報 CH04 S13
What is good practice for volume groups protected by threat detection?
Configure a schedule for regular snapshots
官方建議為這些 Volume Group 設定定期建立 Snapshot 的排程。
Besides ransomware and wiperware, what other attack type does IBM FlashSystem detect?
IBM FlashSystem 除 Ransomware 與 Wiperware 外，也偵測 Exfiltration 攻擊。
What does the Safeguarded Copy function create?
Cyber-resilient point-in-time copies that cannot be changed or deleted through user errors, malicious actions, or ransomware
Safeguarded Copy 建立無法因人為錯誤、惡意行為或勒索軟體而變更或刪除的 Cyber-resilient 時間點 Copy。
Concept Guide Ch18 Safeguarded Copy function
How are Safeguarded snapshots created with the internal scheduler?
By assigning a snapshot policy with the Safeguarded option to a volume group
將勾選 Safeguarded 的 Snapshot Policy 指派給 Volume Group，系統即建立 Immutable Snapshot。
Who can delete a Safeguarded snapshot before its expiration time?
只有 Security Administrator 可以提早刪除 Safeguarded Snapshot。
Which action can a system administrator perform on Safeguarded copy objects?
Associate a Safeguarded snapshot policy with a volume group
System Administrator 可建立 Safeguarded Volume Group、指派 Volume、關聯 Policy；不能刪除 Safeguarded Snapshot 或移除 Policy 關聯。
Concept Guide Ch4 Safeguarded snapshot user roles
When can you NOT configure Safeguarded snapshots with an external scheduler?
If the volume group has a Safeguarded backup policy assigned
If the volume group has hosts
若 Volume Group 已指派 Safeguarded Backup Policy，就不能再以外部排程設定 Safeguarded Snapshot。
What does it mean that snapshots are immutable?
Their content is protected from manipulation by hosts
They cannot be deleted by anyone
They are stored in the cloud
Snapshot 為 Immutable，內容受保護不會被 Host 修改。
What does the Separation of duties principle provide for Safeguarded backups?
Operations are restricted to a subset of users with specific roles
Separation of Duties 讓 Safeguarded 相關作業只限特定角色的使用者，防止非特權使用者危害資料。
Can Safeguarded copies be mapped directly to hosts?
Safeguarded Copy 不能直接映射給 Host，以防應用程式變更。
What does Two Person Integrity (TPI) require?
Two security administrators to work together to complete critical or risky tasks
TPI 要求兩位 Security Administrator 合作完成關鍵或高風險作業，降低資料遺失與誤操作風險。
Concept Guide Ch18 Two person integrity
When TPI is enabled, what role are members of security administrator user groups assigned?
啟用 TPI 時，Security Administrator 群組的使用者改為 Restricted Security Administrator，群組本身保留原角色。
Under TPI, what process is required to remove a Safeguarded snapshot?
A role elevation request approved by another security administrator
TPI 下刪除 Safeguarded Snapshot 需提出角色提升請求，並由另一位 Security Administrator 核准。
What is required to enable TPI?
Two users with the security administrator role
啟用 TPI 需要兩位具 Security Administrator 角色的使用者，可為本機、遠端或混合。
Who can disable TPI after it is enabled?
A user with an approved TPI request
TPI 啟用後，需具核准 TPI 請求的使用者才能停用。
Why might snapshot policies be suspended during a cyberattack?
Snapshots taken during an attack can contain malicious data
攻擊期間的 Snapshot 可能含惡意資料或軟體，因此可暫停 Snapshot Policy 直到釐清受影響資料。
Concept Guide Ch7 Suspending snapshot policies
Which IBM bundle combines copy data management with ransomware detection?
IBM Storage Sentinel 結合 IBM Storage Copy Data Management 的 Safeguarded Copy 與內建 Ransomware 偵測。
What does security scan software do in an IBM Storage Copy Data Management configuration?
Runs ransomware detection on every Safeguarded backup
可註冊專用的 Security Scan Server，在每個 Safeguarded Backup 上執行 Ransomware 偵測。
Concept Guide Ch14 Security scan software
Which restriction applies to Safeguarded source volumes?
They must be in an ownership group
Safeguarded Source Volume 不能在 Safeguarded Backup Location、不能是 Mirrored Volume、不能在 Ownership Group、不能用於 Cloud Backup。
Which command creates an external Safeguarded policy whose schedule is set by external software?
`mksafeguardedpolicy -external` 表示排程由外部軟體設定。
Why should Safeguarded Copy configuration be tested regularly?
To ensure Safeguarded backups are ready in the event of a cyberattack
設定完成後應定期測試，確保遭受攻擊時 Safeguarded Backup 可用。
What does replication alone NOT protect against, which Safeguarded snapshots address?
Data corruption and cyberattacks replicated to the remote site
Replication 會把損毀資料一起複製，需另用 Safeguarded Snapshot 防範資料損毀與網路攻擊。
Which snapshot state indicates a snapshot is maintaining the point-in-time image?
ready：已建立未觸發；active：維持時間點影像；deleting：刪除中；dependent_deleting：待 Clone 或 Restore 用完後自動刪除。
What does the dependent_deleting snapshot state mean?
The snapshot is to be deleted but is still used by a clone, thin-clone, or restore
The snapshot is ready to be triggered
dependent_deleting 表示已指示刪除，但仍被 Clone、Thin-clone 或 Restore 使用，用完後自動刪除。
Where do snapshots consume capacity by default?
In the parent volume's storage pool
Snapshot 預設佔用 Parent Volume 所在 Pool 的容量，也可放到該 Pool 的 Child Pool。
Snapshots created after an anomaly is detected link to what?
偵測到異常之後建立的 Snapshot 會連結到異常的 Fix Procedure。
Which feature prevents active volumes or host mappings from being deleted inadvertently?
Volume Protection 在偵測到近期 I/O 時防止誤刪 Volume 或 Host Mapping，也是資料保護的一環。
What can be done to the system when a node canister is decommissioned to protect data?
Securely erase data from drives or boot drives
系統提供 Secure Data Deletion，在 Node 或 Node Canister 退役時安全清除 Drive 或 Boot Drive 資料。
What is the snapshot buffer feature designed for?
Managing snapshots for workloads with high peak I/O while minimizing host I/O impact
Snapshot Buffer 吸收高寫入尖峰並分散到兩次 Snapshot 之間，降低對 Host I/O 的影響。
What is required to disable the snapshot buffer feature?
需刪除所有既有 Snapshot 才能停用 Snapshot Buffer，因此啟用前需審慎規劃。
Which statement about the snapshot buffer is correct?
Buffered snapshots cannot be added at any time
It can be disabled at any time
Snapshot Buffer 並非對所有工作負載有效，會限制建立 Snapshot 的時機，且需額外系統資源。
Which version of IBM Storage Insights is available at no cost to IBM Block Storage owners?
IBM Storage Insights 基本版提供 IBM Block Storage 用戶免費使用，Pro 版提供更多功能。
